sql: SELECT var99_1j_eur FROM v_risque_book WHERE book = 'TAUX_EUR' AND date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_risque_book) LIMIT 1000

SELECT STRFTIME(date, '%Y-%m') AS mois, SUM(pnl_eur) AS pnl_total FROM v_pnl WHERE desk = 'Taux' AND date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND date <= CAST('2026-10-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1000
SELECT trader, SUM(ABS(dv01_eur)) AS dv01_abs FROM v_positions WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_positions) GROUP BY trader ORDER BY dv01_abs DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(*) AS jours_depassement_80 FROM v_limites WHERE book = 'FX_SPOT' AND utilisation_pct > 80 LIMIT 1000
SELECT book, COUNT(*) AS depassements FROM v_risque_book WHERE depassement_var = TRUE GROUP BY book LIMIT 1000
SELECT valeur FROM v_marche WHERE serie = 'EUR_10Y' AND date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_marche) LIMIT 1000
SELECT book, SUM(pnl_eur) AS pnl_total FROM v_pnl GROUP BY book ORDER BY pnl_total LIMIT 1000

SELECT date, var99_1j_eur FROM v_risque_book WHERE book = 'TAUX_EUR' AND date > CAST('2026-10-30' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '30' DAY ORDER BY date LIMIT 1000
SELECT desk, COUNT(DISTINCT trader) AS nb_traders FROM v_positions GROUP BY desk ORDER BY nb_traders DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT date) FROM v_positions LIMIT 1000
SELECT AVG(valeur) AS taux_moyen FROM v_marche WHERE serie = 'EUR_2Y' AND date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' LIMIT 1000
SELECT DISTINCT book FROM v_positions WHERE desk = 'Taux' LIMIT 1000
SELECT book, utilisation_pct FROM v_limites WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_limites) ORDER BY utilisation_pct DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT (SELECT SUM(pnl_eur) FROM v_pnl WHERE trader = 'Robert') - (SELECT SUM(pnl_eur) FROM v_pnl WHERE trader = 'Petit') AS ecart_pnl LIMIT 1000
SELECT SUM(pnl_eur) AS pnl FROM v_pnl WHERE desk = 'Taux' AND date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_pnl) LIMIT 1000
